objects.evidence: Raw Ex108 and Ex107/p12.m5 match producer lines22-33 and private-module lines21-38. WithLp.ofLp exposes coordinates; vecMulVec is the real outer product; Matrix.one is the identity. The decoder local name n=q+1 is a harmless local dimension alias, not the source high-frequency n=2q+1.

No claim is made that these modules construct the original joint Gaussian family or formally transport its row maps to mu; that bridge remains outside the accepted scope.

assumptions.evidence: No covariance identity, retained expectation, moment, invariance, norm bound or good-event hypothesis is supplied by a caller. Producer50-58 invokes an existing Gaussian radius-integrability theorem;93-145 derives canonical symmetry consequences. Private63-81 materially consumes producer integrability and equality. Cross-row independence is ambient source context and unnecessary for these two marginal means.
